page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; signature line "Ee 3" and catchword "ELEN-" at the foot right.

main_text.p: lo crudo, aut quomodocunque præpa-rato, id quod à Sole auferri, atque in aërem diffundi cum spiritu sanguinis dicitur, posse vel ad partem læsam devenire, perlongissima spatia locorum, vel idoneum esse ad vulnera vel ulcera quæcunque sananda. Quæ verò pro tali Curatione probanda fuêre propofita, cùm solidè sint refutata, sitque nervosè demonstratum superstitioni & fraudibus Diaboli eadem esse implicita; Concludimus tandem, revera superstitiosam ac magicam exiftere illam Vulnerum & Vlcerum Curationem decantatam, quæ per Pulverem Sympatheticum peragi statuitur: à quo adeo Vir pius toto animo adhorreat!
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the facing page is present in the lower half and was not transcribed. Catchword and signature read as printed; the scan is partly faded.
